summary: Southern Cross Acquisition II Corp. filed an 8-K reporting its IPO closing on August 27, 2026. It sold 7,652,630 units at $10.00 each (including partial over-allotment), raising gross proceeds of $76,526,300. Each unit comprises one ordinary share, one warrant exercisable at $11.50, and one right to receive one-fourth of a share. Concurrently, the sponsor and underwriter representative purchased 224,932 private units. This is a SPAC IPO, not a special situation requiring categorization.
